question: Which goddess stationed at the brahmarandhra grants constant protection?
premises: Protection is sought at the brahmarandhra
The protection is to be constant
The goddess is named Mātaṅgī and situated there
inference: The goddess Mātaṅgī, situated at the brahmarandhra, should always protect.
plain_english: May the goddess named Mātaṅgī, situated in the brahmarandhra, always protect.
